name: Get Used to Disappointment
text:
Requirements Your turn begins, and one target within 30 feet failed an attack roll or skill check against you on its last turn.

---
You capitalize on an opponent's failure with smug attitude and swagger, reminding them of the gap in skill between you and your opponent. You attempt to demoralize traits=bravado the opponent. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.
